name: Jesus: The Way, The Truth, and The Life
original_name: Jesus: The Way, The Truth, and The Life
overview: Filmed on location in the Holy Land, Jesus: The Way, The Truth, and The Life is a new and fresh look at Jesus --- who he is, what he is really like, what he taught, and what he did for our salvation.  This encounter with Christ will inspire and empower you to center your entire life around him as you come to know and love him in an ever-deeper and more intimate way.
